v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Allelúia, * Dóminus regnávit, decórem índuit, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty, alleluia, alleluia.
Shout with joy to God * all the earth, alleluia.

text.la: Benedícam te * in vita mea, Dómine: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas, allelúia.
text.en: I will bless thee all my life long * and in thy name I will lift up my hands, alleluia.

text.la: Tres púeri * iussu regis in fornácem missi sunt, non timéntes flammam ignis, dicéntes: Benedíctus Deus, allelúia.
text.en: The three young boys * cast into the furnace by the king, fearing not the flames of fire, said: Blessed be God, alleluia.

text.la: Allelúia, * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
text.en: Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

v.en: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with beauty.

r.la: Índuit Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se virtúte.
r.en: The Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded Himself with power.

text.la: Magíster, * quod est mandátum magnum in lege? Ait illi Iesus: Díliges Dóminum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, allelúia.
text.en: Master, which is the great commandment * in the law? Jesus said unto him: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, alleluia.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, Dómine, pópulo tuo diabólica vitáre contágia: et te solum Deum pura mente sectári.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, grant thy people grace to withstand the temptations of the devil, and with pure hearts to follow thee the only God.

office.title: Dominica XVII Post Pentecosten I. Octobris
